description: Used-vehicle inspection (condition) report produced by an inspection body for a dealer or buyer: who inspected the vehicle and for whom, the vehicle's identity and odometer reading, the condition rating of each component group, brake test and tyre measurements, diagnostics and the inspector's conclusions.

report.description: Report-level identifiers from the page header and Assignment section.

inspection_company.description: Organization that carried out the inspection and issued the report, as printed in the footer, e.g. DEKRA Automotive (PTY) Ltd.

report_title.description: Title printed at the top of the report, e.g. USED CAR REPORT.

report_number.description: Report number printed after 'Report No:' in the page header, digits only.

client.description: Client the inspection was carried out for, from the Client row of the Assignment section.

technician.description: Name of the technician who performed the inspection, from the Technician section.

vehicle.description: The inspected vehicle, from the Vehicle Data section.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number exactly as printed in the Vehicle Data section, without spaces.

model_year.description: Year Model as a four-digit integer.

odometer_km.description: Km Reading as a whole number of kilometres, ignoring thousands separators and the KM unit, e.g. '143,723 KM' is 143723.

registration_number.description: Registration Number (licence plate) as printed, or null if blank.

fuel.description: Fuel type, e.g. PETROL or DIESEL.

component_ratings.description: One entry per row of every General Condition table (Interior, Exterior, Engine Gearbox Drivetrain, Axles Undercarriage), in document order.

section.description: Heading of the table the row belongs to, e.g. Interior, Exterior, Engine, Gearbox, Drivetrain, Axles, Undercarriage.

component.description: Component name from the Components column, exactly as printed.

condition.description: Rating from the Condition column exactly as printed, e.g. Very Good, Good, As Expected.

inspection_result.description: Text of the Inspection Result column for this row.

brake_test.description: Rows of the Brake Test Results table.

axle.description: Row label: Front, Rear or Emergency / Parking.

tyres.description: Rows of the Tyre Specification & Measurement table, one per wheel position including the spare.

position.description: Wheel position: Front Left, Front Right, Rear Left, Rear Right or Spare.

production_date.description: Production date code as printed (week and year, e.g. 3323), or null if not readable.

tread_depth_mm.description: Tread depth in millimetres as a number, e.g. '4 mm' is 4.

diagnostic_summary.description: First sentence of the Diagnostic section: whether active error messages or fault codes were found.

inspection_conditions.description: Each line of the Inspection Conditions section.

general_comments.description: Text of the General Comments line in the Comments section.
